snippet.title: What If You Got $1 Every Time You Blinked? 👁️💸
snippet.description:
An imagined scenario, just for fun. 👁️💸 If every blink paid you $1, you'd make $900 an hour, $14,400 a day... and after one year? 

Blink money or sneeze money? One word 👇

FACT CHECK
• Average spontaneous blink rate is about 15 blinks per minute (studies report roughly 13–20; it varies by person and activity): Healthline https://www.healthline.com/health/how-many-times-do-you-blink-a-day · Malawian young adults study (mean ~16/min) https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9899223/
• Your eyes close by reflex when you sneeze: Live Science https://www.livescience.com/32108-why-do-my-eyes-close-when-i-sneeze.html
• The math: 15 × 60 = $900/hour · 16 awake hours = $14,400/day · × 365 = $5,256,000/year

Not financial advice, obviously. Please don't snort pepper.
